systems: cross-rs: documents that inside a container it must reach the host daemon and that mounted paths must exist on the host (CROSS_CONTAINER_IN_CONTAINER exists for exactly this)
GitHub Actions container jobs: the runner maps only its work and temp dirs into job containers, so tool paths are placed under them
Docker-in-Docker CI (GitLab docker executor): a bind-mount source is resolved by the daemon on its own host, never by the client container
